headline: Underarm roll-on, every morning
footnote: AI illustrations, not real results. Individual results vary.

caption: Nonapeptide + AHA 6% Underarm Roll-On: Apply on clean and dry armpits using the roller and allow to dry before getting dressed; AM, every day. For external use only. Patch test recommended. The two frames are AI illustrations, not results.
